name: Plumbing board (2 weeks)
description: Our plumbing cadence — texts + emails over ~14 days (emergencies → booking → paid on-site → pipeline → campaigns → soft close). Shown as a flow graph on the Board tab.

stages.label: Day 0 · Text intro
stages.hint: First touch — after-hours drain / water-heater angle.

stages.label: Day 1 · Email opener
stages.hint: Email — booking + dispatch for plumbing shops.

stages.label: Day 3 · Text booking
stages.hint: Online booking while you're on a job.

stages.label: Day 5 · Email paid on-site
stages.hint: Get paid on the spot — card / ACH / financing.

stages.label: Day 8 · Text pipeline
stages.hint: Estimates going quiet during service-call weeks.

stages.label: Day 11 · Email campaigns
stages.hint: Past customers + review asks after every job.

stages.label: Day 14 · Text soft close
stages.hint: Soft close — book or opt out.
